title: Playboy May 1983 Nastassia Kinski Helmut Newton Complete w/ Centerfold
conditionDescription: Complete w/ centerfold. Covers clean and bright with light handling wear; spine intact. See photos.
descriptionText:
Playboy magazine, May 1983, original $3.00 cover price. Complete w/ Centerfold.

Cover features: Sensational Nastassia Kinski in a startling Helmut Newton pictorial; two finalists from the Mrs. America pageant in an exclusive pictorial; Terrorism in America - is Los Angeles really ready for the '84 Olympics?; Part Two of Norman Mailer's wild Egyptian novel; Jim Palmer - not just another pretty pitcher.

Back cover: Panasonic Ambience Sound boombox ad featuring Earth, Wind and Fire.

Adult collectible - sold to buyers 18+ only. See photos for condition. Ships in a plain, protective mailer.
